title: Gobblin' Hobblin' 3K/5K 2026
seo_title: Gobblin' Hobblin' 3K/5K in Bolivar, MO – Nov 21, 2026
description: The 6th Annual Gobblin' Hobblin' is a 3K fun run or 5K timed race that starts and ends at Bolivar Recreation & Aquatic Center and runs through Greenwood Cemetery and the municipal golf course, with no public streets. Families are welcome, ages 3 and under are free, and leashed pets and strollers are allowed; drinks, snacks and a raffle are included. It takes place November 21, 2026 in Bolivar, Missouri, with check-in at 8 a.m. and the race at 9 a.m.
